one_liner: Luzia+ members see the same card and play an ad for the Advanced reasoning mode their plan already includes.
author: claude-opus-5-5

change.trigger_event: First app open after 3 or more days with no session.
change.subscriber_treatment: Luzia+ members see the same card and can play for the same 3 answers in Advanced reasoning mode, which their plan already includes.
change.what_is_different_here: The Luzia+ paywall (s02) lists 'Advanced reasoning mode' (s02.e03) as a paid feature. Every returning user, free or Luzia+, sees a one-day, 3-answer card for it on the Chats home (s01), under the Luzia+ badge (s01.e02).
change.after_reward: When the 3 answers are used or the day ends, the card goes away until the user's next return after 3 or more days away.
change.rationale: Any returning user, member or not, needs a reason to ask Luzia something today. Three answers in the deeper-thinking mode are that reason, and one card for everyone keeps it simple. Each answer uses real model time, so it pays for itself in higher-earning markets like North America.
